offerLines: I found a separately filed record relating to the incident. Signed 'Commissioner'. No, the catalogue does not tell me who that is. Apparently mystery is a management qualification.
There is an insurance attachment as well. The entry suggests a small insured sum. The typing does not quite sit with the rest of the page.
Compare the characters in the body with the questioned entry. Look at their shapes and alignment, not just how tired the ribbon was.
I have put the comparison on the desk. Examine it when you are ready, then tell me what you can actually support.
discussionLines: A broken e, a low a and an incomplete R in the questioned entry. Those features are not in the reference text.
That gives us a reason to challenge the entry. It does not magically supply the original sum, its author or a beneficiary.
For the personnel side of the cover, ask Marge Gunderson in HR. She may know which records were attached to John's file.
And ask who 'Commissioner' is while you are there. I file aliases. I do not adopt them.
